paper.title_en: Analog regular black holes and black hole mimickers for surface-gravity waves in fluids
paper.abstract_en: Recent advances in the observation of black-hole candidates have renewed interest in probing their near-horizon structure and in searching for departures from the standard singular solutions of general relativity. In this context, significant effort has been devoted to regular black holes and to horizonless black-hole mimickers, motivated primarily by quantum-gravitational effects. Depending on the value of the regularization parameter relative to the object mass, typical spherically symmetric solutions can describe either of these two scenarios. Regular black-hole configurations generically feature an outer and an inner horizon surrounding a maximally symmetric core; the inner horizon in turn triggers mass inflation and semiclassical instabilities. The horizonless branch of the same solutions, by contrast, supports stable inner light rings when sufficiently compact, yet is itself subject to instabilities associated with long-lived quasinormal modes. Here we investigate how to emulate these spacetimes in an analogue-gravity platform based on surface-gravity waves in a shallow-water basin, with the aim of reproducing these instabilities experimentally. We begin by identifying the flow profiles and boundary conditions required to replicate the relevant effective geometries. In particular, we show that the inner-core metrics can be simulated with a non-rotating central-drainage configuration, and we propose a graded-drainage profile to connect them to an asymptotically flat exterior region. We then assess the experimental feasibility of studying the instabilities mentioned above with current technology. Our conclusion is that, while the required setup is realizable in principle, alternative media, such as Bose-Einstein condensates, may offer a more practical route to faithfully capturing the targeted physical features.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文探讨规则黑洞与无视界黑洞模拟体的内视界质量膨胀不稳定性、内光子环及长寿命准正规模不稳定性，并给出在浅水槽表面重力波类比引力平台中复现这些有效几何的方案与可行性评估；主题属于广义相对论基础与黑洞物理相关方向，理论表述清晰且具有实验衔接意义，值得点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 用于流体表面重力波的类比规则黑洞与黑洞模拟体
decision.abstract_zh: 近期对黑洞候选体的观测进展重新激起了对其近视界结构的探测兴趣，以及对偏离广义相对论标准奇点解的追寻。在此背景下，大量工作致力于规则黑洞与无视界黑洞模拟体，其动机主要来自量子引力效应。取决于正则化参数相对于物体质量的取值，典型的球对称解可以描述这两种情形中的任一种。规则黑洞构型一般具有包围最大对称核心的外视界与内视界；内视界反过来会触发质量膨胀与半经典不稳定性。相比之下，同一解的无视界分支在足够致密时支持稳定的内光子环，但其自身也受到与长寿命准正规模相关的不稳定性影响。本文研究如何在基于浅水盆地表面重力波的类比引力平台上模拟这些时空，目的在于实验上重现这些不稳定性。我们首先确定复现相关有效几何所需的流场剖面与边界条件。特别地，我们表明内核度规可以用一个非旋转的中心泄流构型来模拟，并提出一种梯度泄流剖面，以将其连接到渐近平坦的外部区域。然后我们评估用当前技术研究上述不稳定性的实验可行性。我们的结论是，虽然所需的装置原则上可以实现，但替代介质（例如玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体）可能提供一条更实用的途径来忠实捕捉所针对的物理特征。
